title: Jaffer Yateem Hogaye Baqar  Guzar Gaye
body:
Jaffer Asws. Yateem Hogaye Baqir Asws. Guzar Gaye.
bewaou'n Aur Yateemo'n Ko Be Aas Kar Gaye.
1. Karbobala Mein Aapki Aankho Ke Saamne.
moula Sabhi Quraan Ke Paare Bikhar Gaye.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kaanto'n Pe Nange Paoun Chalate Rahe Adoo L.a.
moula Is Haal Mein Kayi'n Meelo'n Guzar Gaye.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hazrat Ko Zeher Zeen Mein Hushhaam L.a. Ne Diya.
jiske Asar Se Paanchve Sarkar Margaye.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Baandha Tha Ek Rassi Mein Bete Ko Baap Ko.
baqir Asws. Bhi Saath Saath The Abid Asws. Jidhar Gaye.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Taboot Uth Raha Hai Jo Hyder Asws. Ke Laal Ka.
zehra S.a. Ne Kaha Ghar Mera Veeran Kar Gaye.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Dafnaya Baap Bete Ne Binte Hussain Asws. Ko.
manzar Wo Bhool Paaye Na Moula Guzar Gaye.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hargiz Kabhi Na Kam Ho Azadari E Hussain Asws.
moula Yeh Baat Bete Ko Talqeen Kar Gaye.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Mirza Kumail Aapke Gham Mein Hain Sogwaar.
kitne Masayeb Aap Pe Moula Guzar Gaye.
